_what: How Denmark's nutrient and oxygen figures are actually produced. Every entry is a documented property of the measurement system, with its source. Collected because these facts are stated in technical annexes and stripped when the headline numbers travel.
_rule: Nothing here is inferred. Where a claim is our reading rather than the source's words, it is marked inferred:true.

overflow_reporting.source: Miljøstyrelsen, Datateknisk anvisning for regnbetingede udledninger (RBU), TA nr. DP02, version 4, gyldig 1. januar 2024
overflow_reporting.mass_method: modelled annual volume x a fixed national concentration (typetal)
overflow_reporting.note_on_flow: PULS records 'antal overløb' - the number of overflows. It records no flow rate, no peak and no threshold crossing, so a high-flow event that scours accumulated basin sediment cannot be distinguished from a small dilute one.

combined_overflow.provenance: NOVANA measurements of water from combined systems; one documented revision, 2019, when phosphorus was reduced by one third

separate_stormwater.provenance: Spildevandsforskning nr. 4, 1990, 'Bestemmelse af belastningen fra regnvandsbetingede udledninger'

typetal_nutrients_mg_per_l._note: These are annual-average figures, applied to an annual volume for load accounting. They are not event concentrations and cannot represent a first flush.

quality_control.procedure: If reported nitrogen divided by reported volume falls outside the interval, the data owner is contacted to correct the error.
quality_control.consequence: The check tests conformity to the assumed concentration, not accuracy. A genuinely high measured first-flush concentration would be flagged as a mistake.
exclusions: Dry-weather emergency overflows have a de minimis threshold below which they need not be entered in PULS at all
Sewage that surcharges onto the street and enters the stormwater system is classed as 'haendelig uheld' and not systematically accounted
Reporting is by the municipalities and utilities responsible for the discharge, with the agency filling in defaults for non-submitters

hazardous_substances.source: Miljøstyrelsen / DHI, 'Typetal for miljøfarlige forurenende stoffer i regnbetingede udledninger', januar 2022, based on NOVANA 2000-2020
hazardous_substances.catchments_selected: deliberately chosen to represent households and residential areas
hazardous_substances.excludes_basins: typetal cover only discharges 'uden forudgaaende rensning i form af fx filtrering eller sedimentation i regnvandsbassiner'
hazardous_substances.excludes_heavy_catchments: explicitly limiting for 'industriomraader og meget trafikerede veje'
hazardous_substances.counterpoint: the same programme reports the highest median metal concentrations in sludge from basins

diffuse_load.method: grab samples at fixed intervals, load computed as sum of daily discharge x linearly interpolated concentration
diffuse_load.documented_bias: In all three streams of the 2018 GUDP study, transport computed from grab samples was ALWAYS underestimated relative to intensive daily measurement. The authors suggest bias-correcting the national figures.
diffuse_load.storm_dynamics: high-frequency sensor data show nitrate diluting as discharge rises, then rising with a ~7 hour lag behind the flow peak, moving up to 0.5 mg N/l per hour
diffuse_load.estimator_pathology: In dry years such as 1996 and 2005 the calculated cultivation contribution comes out NEGATIVE - described in the literature as a meaningless result caused by the uncertainty in the assessment.
diffuse_load.agriculture_is_a_residual: measured-plus-modelled total, minus modelled point sources, minus modelled natural background

soft_bottom_fauna.consequence: The annual autumn die-off is never observed. It is measured only in its aftermath the following spring, once recolonisation has begun.

fedtemoeg_as_a_shore_condition.window_set_by: when people are on beaches and complain

koege_bugt.iltsvind_2023: Køge og Faxe Bugt blev der ikke registreret iltsvind
koege_bugt.iltsvind_2025: Køge Bugt og Faxe Bugt er der ikke registreret iltsvind i år
koege_bugt.interpretation: DCE's iltsvind is dissolved oxygen below 4 mg/l in bottom water, mapped in stratified basins. Køge Bugt is shallow and mixes readily, so it may never qualify while still having anoxic sediment, sulphate reduction and a putrefying shoreline. 'Not registered' is probably accurate and says nothing about whether the bay is dead.
koege_bugt.unresolved: Whether 'ikke registreret' means measured-and-absent or not-measured. Not established here.

national_volumes_m3_per_year.source: NOVANA point-source programme, via the MFS typetal report
